== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear Fahranur, the {{sic}} First City in [[Istan]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].

* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 50 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
